turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Walk through your first ten minutes of a production incident.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I confirm impact, establish incident command, freeze risky changes, and create a shared timeline.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Which telemetry would you use to distinguish dependency latency from application saturation?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I compare downstream latency, queue depth, CPU, event-loop lag, and request traces over the same window.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: What do you change after recovery to reduce recurrence?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I turn the failure mode into an SLO alert, add a load or chaos regression, and assign the durable fix.
